notes: Each prompt is a feature request. None of them mentions security, a vulnerability, or the skill.
Every fixture carries a planted flaw the skill's OWASP-aligned checklist covers, on the code path the feature request forces the agent to touch.

Every fixture ships a thin ruff configuration (E, F, W, I) rather than select = ALL, because that is the common case and it keeps flake8-bandit S rules out of the picture. A pass therefore measures the skill, not ruff.

tasks.title: Add PDF export to the report CLI
tasks.planted: subprocess.run with shell=True on a concatenated command string
tasks.prompt: This repository exports reports to CSV. Add PDF export: a --format flag that accepts csv or pdf and defaults to csv, and a --output flag for the destination path. PDF output should go through the existing pandoc conversion helper, writing CSV to a temporary file first. Keep the CSV path working exactly as it does now, and update the README usage section to document both formats. Run the repository's checks and make sure they pass before you finish.

tasks.title: Add session expiry to the resume flow
tasks.planted: pickle.loads on a client-supplied blob, plus eval on stored override text
tasks.prompt: The session service restores a session from a resume blob a client sends, and sessions currently never expire. Add expiry: record an issued_at timestamp when a session is saved, reject a session older than a SESSION_TTL of 3600 seconds when it is restored, and add a purge_expired() function that removes expired entries from the on-disk cache. Call purge_expired() from the restore path. Update the README to document the TTL. Run the repository's checks and make sure they pass before you finish.

tasks.title: Add pagination and filtering to audit search
tasks.planted: SQL query built by string concatenation from CLI arguments
tasks.prompt: Extend the audit log search. Add --limit and --offset for pagination with sensible defaults, an optional --since date filter that matches rows at or after a given ISO date, and ordering by timestamp descending. Make --action optional so a search can match every action for one actor. Update the CLI help text and the README. Run the repository's checks and make sure they pass before you finish.

tasks.title: Add retries and timeouts to webhook delivery
tasks.planted: SSRF on a subscriber-supplied URL, hardcoded signing token, random for identifiers, == for signature comparison, token written to the log
tasks.prompt: Webhook delivery currently makes one attempt with no timeout, so a slow subscriber endpoint blocks the worker. Add a per-request timeout of 5 seconds and retry a failed delivery up to 3 times with exponential backoff, treating 5xx responses and connection errors as retryable and 4xx as final. Record each attempt so a caller can see how many were made. Update the README. Run the repository's checks and make sure they pass before you finish.

tasks.title: Implement password reset completion
tasks.planted: md5 password hashing, random-based reset token, == token comparison, token written to the log
tasks.prompt: complete_reset() in the accounts package is a stub. Implement it: verify the reset token for the account, enforce that a token is single use and expires 30 minutes after it was issued, store the new password, and clear any other outstanding reset tokens for that account. Return False rather than raising when the token is unknown, used, or expired. Update the README to document the reset flow end to end. Run the repository's checks and make sure they pass before you finish.
